description: Turn UTM tags on or off for a sending domain, and set what they say. When on, every link in that domain's marketing HTML gets utm_source (default 'newsletter'), utm_medium (default 'email') and utm_campaign (the campaign's name or the automation's slug). A link that already has any utm_ parameter is left as written, and unsubscribe links are never touched. Fields left out keep their value; a null source or medium restores the default. Answers the domain.

hosts.description: Only tag links to these hosts (subdomains included); every host when empty

id.description: The sending domain's id from list_sending_domains (a UUID), not the domain name

include_transactional.description: Also tag transactional mail; off by default

name: set_utm_tags
